description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces, constants, and a class for interacting with the Nextcloud Deck API, including methods for fetching boards, stacks, cards, and comments.

classes.name: NextcloudDeckClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Nextcloud Deck API, providing methods to fetch boards, stacks, cards, and comments.

methods.name: fetchWrapper
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests to the main API endpoint with authorization.

methods.name: fetchWrapperOCS
methods.description: Internal method to perform GET requests to the OCS API endpoint with authorization.

methods.name: getBoardDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific board by ID.

methods.name: getStacks
methods.description: Fetches stacks for a specific board.

methods.name: getStacksArchived
methods.description: Fetches archived stacks for a specific board.

methods.name: getStackDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific stack.

methods.name: getCardDetails
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific card.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific card.
